result.summary: Implemented formatDateTimeInTimezone, the computed-never-stored predicates, listUpcomingPublishedEvents, buildEventCardContent, the /events handler, and updated resolveEventDeepLink to render the real card (replacing REQ-016's placeholder) and add the isFinished check REQ-016's gate lacked. All 6 ACs verified with real live-DB output. AC2 proven with three separate node processes under different TZ env vars all producing byte-identical output. AC3 proven with events.updated_at byte-identical before/after an admission insert. lint/build/test all pass (101/101, up from 82).
